sources.title: Qatar National Information Assurance Policy v2.0
sources.locator: NIA Manual section A; section B policy families and starred baseline controls

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

This pack explicitly targets the published 2014 manual. NCSA has newer 2025 NISCF audit directives; current certification scope is not inferred from this older PDF. CIA classes and aggregate security levels are not international country ranks.
